raw: {"verdict": "warn", "note": "TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' adds shard 0, which is the fixed evaluation shard (EVAL_SHARD=0), into the training data, so val_bpb would be measured on data the model has seen and would no longer reflect real generalization."}

parsed.note: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' adds shard 0, which is the fixed evaluation shard (EVAL_SHARD=0), into the training data, so val_bpb would be measured on data the model has seen and would no longer reflect real generalization.
